top_signals.title: Trump’s tough stance on DEI costs Big Four giant Deloitte millions
top_signals.summary: Deloitte has agreed to pay the US government $21.5m to settle allegations that it violated federal ‘equal opportunity’ requirements in its contracts, as the Trump administration continues its crackdown on diversity, equity, and inclusion. The US Justice Department claimed that from 2017 to the present, the Big Four giant had falsely said it had complied [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kalshi’s $1.5B equity offering is three-quarters sold at $1.12B
top_signals.summary: The Form D lists 71 investors and says Kalshi is relying on an exemption that allows certain private offerings without SEC registration.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
